page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, paired with 32.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks position this instance primarily in the lower-to-average tiers. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests via stress-ng and Geekbench rank in the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively, reflecting the older architecture of the underlying processor. Memory read bandwidth is similarly limited, though large-block write bandwidth achieves average tiering. Cryptographic and vector processing capabilities are supported via AVX, AVX-512F, and AES instructions, which help maintain average scores in Passmark CPU extended instruction tests.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation but modest computational throughput, the ecs.sn2.xlarge is best suited for workloads requiring predictable resource availability without high-performance demands. Suitable applications include moderate web serving, basic database operations, and lightweight utility tasks. It is less optimal for intensive compilation, heavy cryptography, or large-scale LLM inference, where its performance falls into the lower percentiles.
